wish_topics.evidence_span: I'd want people to be able to feel, durably and not just in flashes, that other people's inner lives are as real as their own
The other person becomes a category, an obstacle, a statistic, a voice in a comment section
other people's inner lives are as real as their own
When people do see each other clearly, a lot of things that looked like intractable conflicts get smaller or at least more human
I'd pick the one that shifts the ground under so many other problems rather than tackling one of them directly
I'd like that gap to hurt people less

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: Understanding people can also make them easier to manipulate
some conflicts are real conflicts of interest that no amount of empathy dissolves
So I don't think it fixes everything
